newsitem.title: UK: Enron buys PanEnergy UK gas retail.
newsitem.headline: Enron buys PanEnergy UK gas retail.

text.p: Enron Corp subsidiary Enron Europe said on Tuesday it had purchased from PanEnergy Corp of Houston its UK retail gas marketing arm.
PanEnergy Services UK employs 23 people retailing to 2,600 industrial and commercial gas consumers at 4,200 sites in Britain.

"This acquisition represents a significant step forward in our effort to provide a full range of energy services to all sectors in the UK energy market," said Mark Frevert, president and CEO of Enron Europe.
Enron said it will rename the retail business Enron Direct.
David Pope, previously vice president of Enron Europe's wholesale gas marketing, will lead Enron Direct.
